algorithm: dual-system architecture: Eagle-2 VLM (System 2, reasoning) feeding a DiT flow-matching action head (System 1, acting) via alternating cross-/self-attention; K=4-step forward-Euler denoising at inference; latent-action VQ-VAE for labeling action-less video
hand: Fourier dexterous hands, on the Fourier GR-1 humanoid; DoF/finger count not stated
arm: Fourier GR-1 humanoid (bimanual arms + waist + neck); also evaluated with a Franka Emika Panda arm + parallel-jaw gripper (RoboCasa Kitchen) and Panda arms + dexterous hands (DexMimicGen suite)
sim: RoboCasa (Kitchen and GR-1 Tabletop benchmarks); DexMimicGen (cross-embodiment suite and sim pretraining-data generation); underlying physics engine and timestep not stated
headline_metric: success rate (%), sim (Table 2, avg over 100 trials/task) and real-world (Table 3)
headline_value: Sim, 100 demos/task (Table 2): GR00T-N1-2B 32.1%/66.5%/50.0%/45.0% avg (RoboCasa/DexMG/GR-1/Average) vs Diffusion Policy 25.6%/56.1%/32.7%/33.4% avg; Real-world, full data (Table 3): GR00T-N1-2B 82.0%/70.9%/70.0%/82.5%/76.8% avg (Pick-and-Place/Articulated/Industrial/Coordination/Average) vs Diffusion Policy full-data 36.0%/38.6%/61.0%/62.5%/46.4% avg
human_data: Ego4D, Ego-Exo4D, Assembly-101, HOI4D, HoloAssist, RH20T-Human, EPIC-KITCHENS -- 181.3M frames / 2,517.0 hr of human egocentric video with no ground-truth actions, labeled via a shared cross-embodiment latent-action VQ-VAE codebook
paper_code_mismatch: The parsed code repo (Isaac-GR00T, commit 51d4c89f) is a later N1.7 generation, not the paper's GR00T-N1-2B: VLM backbone changed from the paper's Eagle-2 to Cosmos-Reason2-2B (via Qwen3-VL); action horizon expanded from the paper's stated H=16 to 40; state/action dimensions expanded from 29 to 132; DiT layers changed from 32 to 16; embodiment scope widened to include Unitree G1, AgiBot G1, and a 'YAM' arm not described in the paper.
note_gaps: Fourier dexterous hand DoF/finger count is never stated in the parsed paper or code text; the flow-matching loss (Eq. 1) is an unextracted math image, not parseable text; Table 2's DexMG column (66.5%/56.1%) is arithmetically inconsistent with Table 4's per-task breakdown (58.5%/46.9%), an internal mismatch the note flags but does not resolve; no total real-trial count is given across the four real-world task categories, only per-task trial counts (10 typical, 5 for Machinery Packing, 15 for the two generalization probes).
backbone: Eagle-2 VLM (SmolLM2 LLM + SigLIP-2 image encoder), language component kept frozen during pre- and post-training
action_head: DiT (diffusion-transformer) flow-matching action head, action chunk H=16, closed-loop at 120Hz, K=4-step forward-Euler denoising at inference, plus an auxiliary L_det MSE term (L = L_fm + L_det)
pretrain_data: data pyramid, 592.9M frames / 8,375.7 hr total (Table 7): real-robot teleop (GR-1 + OXE subsets [DROID, RT-1, Language Table, Bridge-v2, MUTEX, Plex, RoboSet] + AgiBot-Alpha + RH20T-Robot, 262.3M/3,288.8 hr), human video (Ego4D etc., 181.3M/2,517.0 hr, latent-action labeled), DexMimicGen/RoboCasa simulation (125.5M/1,742.6 hr), neural-generated video (23.8M/827.3 hr)
dexterous_evidence: "This benchmark focuses on dexterous hand control using the GR-1 humanoid robot equipped with Fourier dexterous hands." (Sec. 4.1, GR-1 Tabletop Tasks)
